audience: PB4T coordinators and departmental training leads reviewing fictional weekly drills; no operational authority is implied.
primaryTask: Load or edit PB4T proposals, inspect shared conflicts, optimize once, inspect counterproposals, coverage and personnel heatmap, then deliberately acknowledge the synthetic draft.
successOutcome: Five baseline drills allocated with no collisions; Engineering moves to Tuesday 09:00 and Weapons Tuesday 11:00, 480 person-minutes; every due fictional occurrence satisfied and acknowledgment remains local.

screens.name: Weekly planning board
screens.purpose: Policy/provenance header; scenario loader and secondary PB4T JSON editor; primary Optimize schedule; seven-day board with allocations and per-row edit controls.

screens.name: Evidence and review
screens.purpose: Linked agent proposals/rejections/counterproposals, initial and final collisions, daily heatmap with numeric cells, prior-duty totals, all occurrence deadlines/statuses, and review acknowledgment/export.

states.empty: Explain no draft and offer Load synthetic baseline; never treat empty JSON as a valid empty roster.
states.loading: Disable duplicate invocation and acknowledgment; show Calculating synthetic schedule and Cancel. Requests run in a worker thread; cancel aborts fetch and terminates worker through disconnect; preserve previous result.
states.error: Keep malformed editor and last saved valid draft. Inline specific error code; invalid/infeasible/budget-exhausted/stale states visibly block review and offer correction or recompute.
states.success: Show Feasible synthetic draft, zero remaining collisions, every drill, explicit unapproved policy and first-feasible limitation. Acknowledgment requires evidence checkbox and current saved computed content.

persistence: LocalStorage stores input draft, last computed response and acknowledged revision. Autosave unsaved editor separately; edits immediately invalidate acknowledgment. Reload preserves state. Load/reset while dirty requires Save draft or Discard draft; #discard-draft is deliberate discard. Explicit load baseline restores exact input fixture. No server persistence or operational publication.
recovery: Edit start or crew inline; Apply edit saves dirty board but derived values stale. Check board reveals collisions and disables review. Optimize recomputes and commits a valid result, clears acknowledgment. Invalid input never overwrites last valid result. Export includes warning, policy, unresolved outputs and current review status; disable export of stale derived results with explanation.
keyboard: Use labeled native buttons, selects, textareas, number inputs and checkbox with logical tab order, visible focus and live status/error announcements. No drag-only editing; rows editable by keyboard. Desktop board has seven day columns; narrow viewport becomes day sections with wrapping evidence and heatmap accessible horizontal scroll, numeric values plus text legend; no color-only meaning. Restrained system typography, consistent primary accent, readable dense evidence, touch targets and reduced motion.
